releaseName: Prepare an application: cover letter and interview questions
summary: One sprint since voice answers in the career interview (milestone 72). Each application on the web has a Prepare panel that drafts a cover letter or a set of interview questions from the career record (#2215, #2216, #2217). Every paragraph or talking point shows the facts it cites, and the server refuses a draft that cites a withheld fact, states a number no cited fact holds, in digits or in words, or talks about the record instead of the candidate's work (#2242, #2243, #2244). Drafts download as Markdown and are not stored. Agent tokens now expire after 90 days by default, a workspace holds at most 20 active ones, and each work journal note names the token that filed it (#2229, #2231). The critic's findings name the claim, section or requirement they target (#2235).
knownLimitations: Drafting needs content screening in rules+model mode, recorded consent to send career material to Anthropic, and a Claude route; without them the panel says why and the rest of the page works. One request may spend up to US$0.50. A draft can still hold a mild inference, such as a trait drawn from a skill, so the panel asks the candidate to check each sentence against its sources. The skill-to-role rule is in the prompt and is verified by walks, not by a deterministic check.
